# Stripchat India Agency

> Information about creator onboarding, platform guidance, privacy, safety, and applying to the Stripchat India Agency. The website is intended for adults 18 and older in India and provides Hindi and English support.

## Important pages

- [Home](/): Overview, requirements, how the process works, privacy information, and common questions.
- [Apply](/apply): Application information and next steps.
- [Help and safety](/help): Contact options and guidance about privacy, safety, payments, and agency changes.
